title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy Cooper; 2 hitachi mics > hitachi trq-222; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc > fission > 16/44.1 xACT flac; power by furman p-2400IT; transfer & mastering - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a jovial Uncle John’s Band and lively St. Stephen, though Dark Star suffers from clipping.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its warm crowd ambience – especially the laughing and crying during St. Stephen and the joyful feel of Uncle John’s Band – and for Jerry Garcia’s backing vocals and rare pedal‑steel work. The audience source lets listeners hear the room, but a noticeable clipping loss in Dark Star mars an otherwise enjoyable performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on musical moments and atmosphere (show quality) combined with a decent but imperfect audience recording (recording quality). Only one review, so confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd audible adds atmosphere; clipping loss on Dark Star early in the performance; overall lively but not pristine sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Engaging first‑set vibe with audience reactions, a highlight on Uncle John’s Band; Dark Star cuts off early, reducing its impact.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Backing vocals and pedal steel playing noted positively
